rows.label: tlk43200142_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Listen carefully! You know Blades have
skills that help with adventuring,
right?

rows.label: tlk43200142_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Among them, Blades with special skills
like Lockpicking or Keen Eye are rare.

rows.label: tlk43200142_01_msg0003
rows.name:
If you meet a Blade like that,
treasure that Blade.

rows.label: tlk43200142_01_msg0005
rows.name:
A good Driver needs little
bits of knowledge like this too.
